name: Steelgrill's Depot
summary: East of Kharanos, Steelgrill's Depot keeps Alliance vehicles and machinery in working order. Beldin Steelgrill and his crew handle repairs, tinker supplies, and salvage efforts.

sections.title: A Bastion of Steam and Steel
sections.body: Steelgrill's Depot rings with clanking metal, hissing steam vents, and the hum of experimental engines. Just off the snowy road east of Kharanos, dwarven miners and eccentric gnome engineers gather among heavy machinery, mechanized walking frames, and stockpiles of raw ores hauled from nearby quarries. Trogg disruptions and shortages of mechanical supplies trouble Dun Morogh. Beldin Steelgrill and his crew keep Alliance machinery in working order, making the depot an indispensable stop for travelers seeking spare parts or technical guidance in the bitter cold.

faq.answer: Steelgrill's Depot is a workshop and outpost in Dun Morogh, just down the road east of Kharanos. It caters to miners, tinkerers, and field technicians, with heavy machinery to maintain.
Beldin Steelgrill manages the depot with fellow dwarven and gnomish crafters. They maintain the surrounding machinery and oversee mining operations.
The depot houses trade suppliers, repair services, and trainers for craftsmen seeking to hone their engineering and gathering skills in the field.

angles.text: As an aspiring engineer traveling through Dun Morogh, you can rest at this open-air laboratory surrounded by steam machinery and tinkering supplies.
As a gnome, you may work with your dwarven hosts at the depot. Exiled gnomish tinkers often use its forge fires and spare components to keep their salvaged contraptions running.
